corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez construct state with pronominal suffix 'ስምዑ ለዮሐንስ' (his second testimony, of John) has the 2nd order Ka'eb stroke on the right of ዐ.

Canonical Ge'ez citation of John 4:2 ('ወባሕቱ ኢያጥመቀ ለሊሁ ኢየሱስ') — lookalike glyph check: wait, looking closely at the image, the printed letters are indeed ወለሊሁሰ (or ወአሊሁሰ with faded top bar of ለ). Specifically, in Ge'ez John 4:2 'ወባሕቱ ለሊሁሰ ኢየሱስ ኢያጥመቀ', here the commentary cites 'ወለሊሁሰ ኢያጥመቀ' ('and he himself did not baptize'). The second character is ለ (from ለሊሁሰ 'he himself'), misread as አ due to faded top bar.
